checks.exercise: Farmer carry with two dumbbells and alternating short walking steps.
checks.equipment: One dumbbell on each side, parallel handles in neutral grip.
checks.setup: Front and side eight-frame sheets inspected; upright torso, head forward.
checks.hands: Both curled hands retain handle sockets; weights stay beside hips.
checks.feet: Alternating swing and stance, at least one support foot, no reconstructed world stance drift.
checks.movement: Body-relative gait loop represents forward camera tracking; limbs return continuously.

limitations: Slow procedural camera-relative walking loop; no visible ground or traveled distance.
Simplified flat-foot gait without heel-to-toe roll; elbows retain about 20 degrees flexion.
Seventeen sampled vertex-to-plate clearances do not certify all mesh/handle collisions or human gait biomechanics.
